subject.title: fix(agents-bind): generate peer format for feishu group bindings

question: Which public Feishu bind grammar should OpenClaw support for conversation peer routing while preserving existing account-scoped `--bind` behavior?
rationale: The patch fixes the reported route shape only by changing documented CLI grammar and persisted binding semantics, and several sibling PRs propose different grammar/ownership choices.

options.title: Preserve account syntax and add explicit peer routing
options.body: Keep `--bind <channel>:<account>` semantics intact, add or choose a clear peer/conversation syntax or plugin-owned resolver, and update docs/tests before merge.

options.title: Adopt this Feishu-specific reinterpretation
options.body: Accept `feishu:<value>` as a group peer by default and own the upgrade risk with docs, migration guidance, and proof that account-scoped setups remain expressible.

options.title: Choose a sibling candidate
options.body: Pause this branch and select another open Feishu bind PR if it better matches the desired grammar and ownership boundary.

recommendation.title: Preserve account syntax and add explicit peer routing
recommendation.body: Keep `--bind <channel>:<account>` semantics intact, add or choose a clear peer/conversation syntax or plugin-owned resolver, and update docs/tests before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The central decision is about the account-scoped agent bind command surface introduced in `96c77025263d`.
